TDA's official Nursery Floral licensee extract contains two current records with legal name and facility name 'MELTING POT PLANTS': certificate 0961719, county Houston, Nursery Floral Class M, expiring 2027-04-30; and certificate 1011543, county Waller, Nursery Floral Class 2 (permanent location that grows, 10 acres or less), expiring 2027-10-31. Both are unexpired. The Stripe entity type is Individual, so no Texas SOS corporate filing is expected; the required trade licence for this activity exists and is active. [https://texasagriculture.gov/Regulatory-Programs/Plant-Quality/Nursery-Floral/Nursery-Floral-Reports-Publications]

An independent government record places the business physically in the Houston metropolitan area. The TDA licensee extract lists 'MELTING POT PLANTS' with a Class 2 permanent licensed premises in Waller county and a Class M temporary-market registration recorded under Houston. Cypress, TX is an unincorporated Houston-metro community straddling the Harris/Waller county line, so the licensed premises is consistent with the declared city. TDA Class 2 is defined as a permanent location that sells and grows nursery stock, corroborating real physical premises rather than a paper-only entity. No consumer-facing footprint was found in four web searches, consistent with the merchant's statement that the retail store is still being opened. [https://texasagriculture.gov/Regulatory-Programs/Plant-Quality/Nursery-Floral/Nursery-Floral-Reports-Publications]

No people-search or data-broker sources were used, and no home address, date of birth, age, relatives or personal phone number was looked up or recorded. No scam, fraud or complaint reports naming the business or the representative were found. [https://texasagriculture.gov/Regulatory-Programs/Plant-Quality/Nursery-Floral/Nursery-Floral-Reports-Publications]

The declared activity is coherent with what the state licence shows the business actually does.
